title: Newscasters Agree: A Christmas Present Or Two Or Ten Edition | CONAN on TBS
summary: A Conan segment compiling local news anchors who all read the same scripted copy during the holiday season. It highlights how homogenized local broadcast news has become.
why: Used as the go-to illustration of corporate-owned local newscasts reading identical scripts.

quote.text: 100s of local newscasts are all using the exact same script, even on trivial human interest stories
